The bad results arrive, the party ends and the hangover appears: the debts accumulated after years of living beyond their means bring many clubs to the brink of disappearance. Large fortunes and foreign investment groups take advantage of these desperate situations, professionalizing the clubs while distancing them from their fans. After being considered demigods, our presidents end up leaving through the back door, but 30 years later they continue to occupy a very special place in collective memory

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Good, The Bad, The Hungry
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: Dr. Mike and his team treat a newborn foal fighting for its life after a difficult birth. Meanwhile, Dr. Chris is attacked by a patient and solves a problem the dogs are having in the spring. Dir.: Martin Baker. UK, Australia

programme.desc: In this issue, we will dive into the brightest and most whimsical palette on the planet. Spain

programme.desc: Zebras are often seen as victims, but in this episode we show a different side to them. We travel to Zambia to meet these majestic animals that not only have amazing abilities to escape predators, but can also be friends and love. France

programme.desc: The Tibetan macaques of Huangshan Mountain face many challenges in harsh environments. This documentary project will explore how these animals adapt to life in the mountains, overcoming natural obstacles and maintaining a unique social hierarchy that helps them survive and thrive.

programme.title: d/f Monkeys and more: our closest relatives
programme.desc: Travel around the world to learn more about hard-working monkeys and their amazing abilities. Primates, like humans, know how to work tirelessly and enjoy leisure. This documentary project explores what we have in common with these intelligent animals, and how their behavior helps us better understand evolution and our own habits. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Juan Luis Santos. Spain

programme.title: d/f Gibbon - a singing monkey. 1 p.
programme.desc: A distinct sound is heard that awakens the quiet forest. Some claim that this sound resembles human singing. These signals serve to convey signals and emotions. These little monkeys protect the life of a huge forest. These are singing monkeys - gibbons. We will reveal the secrets of their mysterious singing. South Korea

programme.title: d/f Gibbon - a singing monkey. 2 s.
programme.desc: A distinct sound is heard that awakens the quiet forest. Some claim that this sound resembles human singing. These signals serve to convey signals and emotions. programme.title: d/s Zog and the heavenly rivers (Drought)
programme.desc: In the heart of the Pantanal in western Brazil - the largest wetland region in the world - lies the kingdom of Zoga, the leader of a troop of howler monkeys. During the rainy season, his house turns into an island. Zog and his relatives have always lived in a rhythm determined by nature. But one day it is broken, and the forest inhabitants face a grueling and long wait for rain. The disappearance of water took everyone by surprise: birds, caimans, monkeys and the real owner of these places - the anaconda Olima. For the first time, the heavenly rivers put Zog's kingdom in danger of extinction. France

programme.title: d/s Zog and the Heavenly Rivers (Time of Water)
programme.desc: The rains were already 40 days late. It was getting hotter day by day. It seemed like it would never rain again. Zog began to consider the sun his enemy, he lost all hope, and his condition began to worry his relatives. The forest was dying without water. For the first time, Zog thought that the end had come for all the inhabitants of the forest crowns. Predators became active and the monkeys' lives were in danger. But finally, the heavenly rivers returned, and life in the rainforest was reborn again. France

programme.title: d/f Titans of the Seas: Family Matters
programme.desc: In the warm waters of Mauritius, the story of a large family of sperm whales develops. Lana's birth begins a journey through their world: from timid Arthur to brave Elliot, from restless Romeo to caring Germine and Cones, who is greeted with glee. But soon this oceanic clan will change again, creating new connections in the limitless depths. France

programme.title: d/f The Mystery of the Life of Seals
programme.desc: The film shows breathtaking footage of the underwater world of gray seals in the Stockholm archipelago. Viewers will learn how these mammals learn to hunt, swim and survive in the harsh conditions of the icy waters of the Baltic Sea. The film also talks about why, despite accusations from fishermen of depleting fish stocks, seals play a crucial role in maintaining the balance of the Baltic ecosystem. Sweden

programme.title: d/f Teide: land born from fire
programme.desc: Prepare for an exciting journey to Teide, a volcano that towers over Tenerife like a guardian from ancient times. In this documentary, you will discover a land born of fire, where every rock bears traces of violent eruptions of the past. Explore unique landscapes reminiscent of the surfaces of other planets and discover how life adapts to these extreme conditions

programme.title: d/s Naturally carnivorous (Teeth and bones)
programme.desc: What makes predators so successful in the fight for survival? The series offers a look at the world through their eyes: the intricacies of hunting, strategies for tracking prey, interaction with the environment and habits that help maintain balance in nature are revealed. The focus is on the adaptations, instincts and intelligence that allow predators to thrive in the harshest environments. Australia

programme.title: d/s Jungle Planet (Fragrant Jungle)
programme.desc: Australia's dry eucalyptus forests are home to many unique animals. Due to forest fires, the area of ​​these eucalyptus groves is steadily shrinking from year to year, and along with them, koalas, parrots and kangaroos are disappearing. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/s Jungle Planet (Tropical Paradise)
programme.desc: The jungles of the American tropics stretch from the south of Brazil to Mexico. The richest and most diverse life flourishes here. This hot and humid place is home to crocodiles, green iguanas and other unique animals. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/s Strange Creatures of the Oceans (End of the Road)

Aquatic life, stretching over billions of cubic kilometers, is fraught with a great variety of amazing and strange inhabitants: from giant to miniature, from bright to inconspicuous, from harmless to poisonous, from prey to hunters. Spain

programme.desc: In the wild it is survival of the fittest, and each creature has its own set of skills and weapons. Viewers will get to know poisonous spiders, fast snakes, camouflaged cuttlefish, ferocious sharks and other deadly animals. This exciting journey will reveal the secrets of the hunters at the top of the food chain. USA

programme.title: d/s Superpowers of animals (Touch)
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? How do bats and moths use their unusual ears and antennae for orientation? In each episode, we explore how these features, which at first glance seem strange, play a key role in survival. Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Max Serio.
